AI Disclosure: No automated screening tools will be used during the application process What you will do Full-stack development of new functionality in existing products. • • Full-stack maintenance development of existing products. • Work with team leads and product managers to plan and assign work items. • Work with the technical support team when troubleshooting issues on released software. • Gather data and analyze the business challenges alongside subject matter experts. • Attend weekly lunch and learn sessions where you will get to learn more about a business topic of the week! Work in a place where you matter - apply now!
